name: Llm & Language
insight: Fastest growing cluster — 1230350% growth rate. 100% of papers from 2020+.
description: The LLM eruption — 24k papers almost entirely from 2022–2025. Focuses on prompting, reasoning, and instruction-following in large language models. Essentially a field that did not exist before 2022.

name: Language & Model
insight: Fastest growing cluster — 283% growth rate. 86% of papers from 2020+.
description: The broader NLP/transformer foundation — 39k papers going back to 2018, covering pre-training, fine-tuning, and benchmark evaluation. The established base from which the LLM cluster grew out of.

name: Time & Method
insight: One of the largest clusters with 234,031 papers spanning Computer Science.
description: A heterogeneous catch-all spanning applied math and computational methods. No single sub-field dominates — it catches papers using generic probabilistic and time-series vocabulary from across domains.

name: Space & Prove
insight: One of the largest clusters with 180,419 papers spanning Computer Science.
description: Pure mathematics — abstract algebra, topology, and functional analysis. Extremely stable vocabulary going back decades, high purity within math, low overlap with CS or physics.

name: Method & Feature
insight: Very recent cluster — median publication year 2023.0. 83% from 2020+.
description: Computer vision feature extraction and object recognition — the classical CV pipeline before and alongside deep learning. Spans detection, segmentation, and learned representations.

name: Robot & Human
insight: Highly focused cluster — 83% purity in cs.RO.
description: Robotics and human-robot interaction — task planning, manipulation, embodied agents. Bridges mechanical systems and machine learning, growing fast as embodied AI accelerates.

name: Planet & Star
insight: Highly focused cluster — 82% purity in astro-ph.EP.
description: Observational astrophysics — planetary systems, stellar evolution, and mass measurement. Mature field with steady output and little interdisciplinary boundary-crossing.

name: Model & Data
insight: Interdisciplinary bridge — spans multiple domains with diversity score 2.26.
description: A large general ML and statistical modeling catch-all. Papers here use broadly applicable methods (regression, simulation, probabilistic models) that fit no more specific cluster.

name: Ray & Gamma ray
insight: Mature field — only 14% growth. Established area with stable vocabulary.
description: High-energy astrophysics — gamma-ray bursts, cosmic rays, and X-ray sources. Pure physics vocabulary, high domain stability, anchored in observational and theoretical astrophysics.

name: Quark & Decay
insight: Mature field — only 19% growth. Established area with stable vocabulary.
description: Particle physics — quark interactions, decay processes, and hadron spectroscopy. Core HEP cluster, very high domain purity, long-running field with stable 3,500 papers/year.
